children: Ultragenyx announced that the Phase 3 Aspire study of apazunersen in Angelman syndrome failed to meet its primary and key secondary endpoints.
Phase 3 Aspire did not achieve primary endpoint: change from baseline in Bayley-4 cognitive raw score, indicating no demonstrated cognitive benefit.
Key secondary endpoint—net response in the Multidomain Responder Index—was not met; no efficacy signal vs control across MDRI components.
Safety profile in Aspire was consistent with prior Phase 1/2 data, with no new safety findings reported.
Company will evaluate the apazunersen program and consider significant expense reductions while supporting its growing commercial business.
